name: The Sprouted Fronds
summary: Following Denalan's botanical experiments at Lake Al'Ameth, the planted frond seeds take root and bloom. This quiet moment marks a successful harvest in understanding Teldrassil's strange and vital flora. Travelers inspecting the garden beds can witness the rapid growth firsthand.

sections.title: A Garden by Lake Al'Ameth
sections.body: Tucked away near Lake Al'Ameth, the botanist Denalan dedicates himself to cataloging the peculiar plant life of Teldrassil. After sowing the seeds recovered from a mysterious shimmering frond, the soil quickly yields result. In his tended planter, strange, trembling fronds shoot up from the rich loam, eager to be gathered and examined.

sections.title: The Strange Flora of the World Tree
sections.body: Teldrassil is young, vast, and teeming with rapid natural development that both fascinates and troubles night elf herbalists. The shimmering fronds and their sprouted offshoots are emblematic of how swiftly life takes hold on the boughs of the great tree, hinting at the powerful yet unpredictable vitality woven into the island's soil.

faq.answer: They are the mature plants that sprouted from seeds sown by Denalan at his lakeside camp. Cultivated from the shimmering fronds found elsewhere in Teldrassil, these peculiar plants tremble with energy when ready for harvest.
Denalan keeps his garden and research camp along the eastern edge of Lake Al'Ameth, southeast of Dolanaar in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Denalan plant these fronds?
faq.answer: Denalan studies the curious and rapid growth patterns of Teldrassil's plant life. By planting seeds in controlled soil, he investigates their nature and tests whether they possess useful restorative or herbal properties.
No. Unlike some of the corrupted or hostile flora elsewhere on the boughs of Teldrassil, these sprouted fronds are harmless botanical specimens waiting to be plucked.
Adventurers first discover a shimmering frond in the wilds of Teldrassil and bring it to Denalan, who plants the seeds in his garden planter to await their sprouting.
The fronds tremble as they await picking. The source does not explain what causes this movement.

angles.text: Denalan's research reflects the practical arts of gathering and studying Teldrassil's unique vegetation, demonstrating how quickly local seeds adapt to nurtured soil.
Tending the newly sprouted flora reflects the kaldorei responsibility to monitor and nurture the life taking root across their young World Tree.
Druids observing Denalan's planter can appreciate the quiet balance of nature, seeing life flourish under attentive care even amid Teldrassil's growing perils.
